run_search_server: run the distributed FAISS search server on a specified port with IPv4 or IPv6 support
create_ResultHeap: create a ResultHeap to combine k-NN search results from multiple sliced dataset queries
use_distribute_weights: use distribute_weights to assign weights to bins for balanced load distribution across workers
search_SplitPerListIndex: search a SplitPerListIndex with query vectors to get k nearest neighbors across sub-indexes
range_search_SplitPerListIndex: perform a range search on SplitPerListIndex to find all vectors within a given radius
